cases.name: Waiting quote and quote revision never hold or move stock; customer must accept quote
Confirmed quote is held by snapshotted manager approval and accountant review
Review approvals are versioned, idempotent and cannot be forged by stale principal or wrong warehouse
Policy changes do not recapture, reprice or remove old approval/payment conditions
Picking and packed states require readiness; confirmed issue posts exact-once and yields SHIPPED
PAID policy cannot fabricate payment; Sales submits pending, Accountant verifies actual money once
Non-self manager policy blocks quote author; disabled policy and stock shortages remain blocked
Accountant uploads a new payment proof and creates one pending receipt; other uploads and money escalation stay forbidden
Old confirmed orders keep native partial issue rules and never acquire a new policy snapshot
Amount approval uses native VAT total and only the configured approver role
Concurrent issues with distinct keys cannot exceed source quantity or double stock movement
Incomplete partner profiles block new orders and cannot be relabeled READY by the paginated SQL filter
Supermarket receipt updates delivered state only after real source issue and complete receipt
Legacy Sales order and tax-profile endpoints enforce current customer assignment
Native price-book approval and non-self rules gate special buyer quotes; minimums fail closed
Fractional VAT and native fee stay exact through payment gate and multiple source shipments
